a.lede: Meta’s board feared that its CEO’s departure could disrupt the company’s AI ambitions. A new stock agreement gives him financial incentives to stay put.
a.title: Mark Zuckerberg Agrees to Stay in California Despite Billionaires’ Tax Ballot Measure

b.lede: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.
b.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta
